environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on ECS Fargate with default task definition. Container runs as root with default Linux capabilities. ALB forwards all traffic directly to container port 8080. No WAF attached. IAM task role has s3:*, logs:*, and ecs:* permissions for operational flexibility. VPC security group allows inbound on port 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.
